description: This file defines the VTTaskManager class responsible for managing workflow tasks in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating, saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing various task types, as well as auxiliary functions for handling task serialization and filtering task types based on modules.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing workflow tasks including creation, retrieval, deletion, and filtering tasks, with support for different task types and serialization.

classes.name: VTTask
classes.description: An abstract base class for all task types, defining the interface and common methods for tasks used in workflows.

methods.name: saveTask
methods.description: Saves a task object into the database, inserting or updating as necessary.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task from the database given its task ID.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task instance of a specified type and associates it with a workflow.

methods.name: retrieveTask
methods.description: Retrieves a task from the database by its ID and unserializes it.

methods.name: getTasksForWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks associated with a specific workflow ID.

methods.name: unserializeTask
methods.description: Unserializes a task string into a task object, ensuring the correct task class is required.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks present in the database.

methods.name: getTaskTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of available task types, optionally filtered based on module.

methods.name: filterTaskTypes
methods.description: Filters the list of task types based on the module, excluding certain task types for specific modules.

methods.name: getTasksForResult
methods.description: Processes a database result set to return an array of task objects.

methods.name: taskName
methods.description: Extracts the task class name from a serialized task string.

methods.name: requireTask
methods.description: Includes the PHP file defining a specific task class.
